description: Create a test role: a kind of account a test acts as, such as Patient or Doctor; two accounts of one kind in one test are two roles. CREATED: Muggle signs each account set's account up itself, and it is disposable. SUPPLIED: the customer provides the account, which is never used up; allowsChanges lets tests change its account-wide facts when a proven way back restores them. Returns the created role.

allowsChanges.description: SUPPLIED only: the customer allows tests to change the account's account-wide facts when a proven way back restores them

name.description: Role name, unique per project ignoring case, e.g. 'Patient'

projectId.description: Project ID (UUID) that owns the test states and roles

source.description: CREATED: Muggle signs the account up itself. SUPPLIED: the customer provides the account

name: muggle-remote-test-role-create
